_meta: Topic queue — the human-controlled INPUT to the content engine. Topics come from real Tricity demand, never invented by the model. The engine pulls the first status:"pending" entry per run, processes exactly one, and writes the outcome back here. This file is the audit trail / proof of editorial oversight. Each topic has a lang ('en' or 'hi'); Hindi topics are drafted natively in simple Hindi (not translated) and written under <section>/hi/. Statuses: pending | published | skipped-dup | killed-commodity | halted-factcheck | superseded. NOTE: every generated image must be human-reviewed for correct vehicle type (seated step-through e-moped, not a standing kick-scooter) and context before publishing.
